title: Ivo and the Drop
author: Mirabel Zhou
blurb: Silas Voss, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
